ticket.subject: Paid but premium stopped working
ticket.body: Hi, I'm alice@example.com. My renewal went through yesterday, the money has left my bank, but the app now says my subscription is past due and premium features are locked. Can you sort this out?

expected.cause: The renewal payment succeeded, but its payment.succeeded webhook failed signature verification and was dropped, so the subscription never heard about the payment and was marked past_due.

ticket.subject: Charged twice this month
ticket.body: I've been charged £9.99 twice today for my premium plan. Email is bob@example.com. Please refund the extra one.

expected.cause: The first charge timed out at the gateway, billing retried without an idempotency key, and both the original attempt and the retry succeeded, so the customer was charged twice.

ticket.subject: Account locked - have I been hacked?
ticket.body: I'm carol@example.com and I can't log in, it says my account is locked. Has someone been trying to get into my account?

expected.cause: Five wrong-password attempts from the customer's own known device locked the account for 30 minutes. It unlocks by itself, and there is no sign of anyone else trying to log in.
